source: SCALE-PLAN.md section 2 (2026-10-10): budgets the user feels at the extreme, measured on the overloaded rig, model time excluded (fake engines answer at once).

regression.note: Against a stored baseline: fail when a p90 is more than 15% and more than 20 ms worse.

slope.note: Turn prep at turn 500 of one resumed session within 70% of turn 10 (10% per doubling over 5.6 doublings), or within 25 ms of it. Judged only when at least 90% of the turns after the first truly resumed the session.

storage.source: STORAGE-AUDIT.md section 6 (2026-10-12): bytes as multiples of M, the messages table's own b-tree (dbstat), measured at the end of each run on the data-dir copy (storage.mjs). Each table counts with its indexes. A table is in a group when its name starts with one of the group's prefixes; no table may be in two.
storage.slopeNote: Bytes per new message over the first 10% of the slope session's turns against the last 10% (live bytes sampled per turn). Judged only with at least slopeMinTurns turns; a late window within slopeFloorBytes per message of the early one passes (page-sized steps on a short window).

metrics.label: Turn prep before the engine (long resumed session)
metrics.description: Sable's resumed long session, turnPrep scenario (pool on): per turn, the turn trace's dispatch.send mark, in ms from the server receiving the message. Only the turn's own trace (the first that started after its own send); turns with no dispatch.send are missing, never filled from memory's pre= field.

metrics.label: Murage-added time to first token (warm session)
metrics.description: turnPrep scenario with the engine pool on: per turn whose engine.acquire says cold=false (a reused warm engine), the engine.first-text mark in ms from the server receiving the message. The fake engine answers at once, so this is Murage's time. Fails when the run had the pool off.

metrics.label: Murage-added time to first token (cold engine start)
metrics.description: coldStart scenario with the engine pool off (the shipped default): per turn on Sable's long session whose engine.acquire says cold=true, the engine.first-text mark in ms from the server receiving the message. Includes the engine process start, initialize, authenticate and session load.

metrics.label: Per-turn prep, turn 10 / 100 / 500 of one session
metrics.description: Slope bot's own thread, one session for up to 500 turns: the p50 dispatch.send prep of the turns among the five ending at turns 10, 100 and 500 that truly resumed the session (resumed=true on the turn's own memory line, no memory continuation reset thread=<slope> line in the turn). Fails when under 90% of the turns after the first resumed, or on any real reset.

metrics.label: Conversation switch (click to rows on screen)
metrics.description: Playwright, ui scenario: click a bot (Claudia or Capt) in the list to its profile button and its last rows visible, in ms, six alternating switches.

metrics.label: Open the longest thread (first page painted)
metrics.description: Playwright, ui scenario: click Sable (the 200k-message thread) from another bot to its newest rows visible, in ms, three times.

metrics.label: Memory search (recall) while a bot captures
metrics.description: memorySearch scenario: per Sable turn on a fresh task, right after a Capt turn (capturing), the duration of the turn's own first memory.bundle span in ms (or its memory line's recall= field when it has none). Sable's turns only.

metrics.label: Memory search success rate while capturing
metrics.description: memorySearch scenario: share of Sable's turns that completed and whose SENT bundle had at least one recall hit (dispatch.send recallHits=, or derived: a recall dropped at the wait counts 0 unless a reset rebuilt it). A turn the server re-dispatched is scored by the re-dispatch. Capt's turns are reported apart (byBot), never mixed in.

metrics.label: Owner memory search (Settings › Memory)
metrics.description: memorySearch scenario: POST /api/memory/action list with a query for Sable (the Settings › Memory search), request time in ms, twelve queries.

metrics.label: Settings › Engines settled
metrics.description: Playwright, ui scenario: from the Engines entry shown in App settings until no API request has been in flight for 500 ms, in ms, three times. The request waterfall of each is in pw-flows-<label>.json.

metrics.label: Bot settings open
metrics.description: Playwright, ui scenario: click Sable's profile button to the Bot settings dialog shown, in ms, three times.

metrics.label: App start usable (server boot + first screen)
metrics.description: Server process start to /api/health OK (three boots), plus a fresh page load to Sable's button in the bot list (three loads); the p50s and p90s of the two are added. The load's request waterfall and navigation timing are in pw-flows-<label>.json.

metrics.label: App start settled (server boot + requests quiet)
metrics.description: As app start usable, but the page part runs until no API request has been in flight for 500 ms.

metrics.label: Routine burst at the top of the hour: own slot (due time plus its place in the spread) to started
metrics.description: routineBurst scenario: routines all due at one minute; per run, startedAt minus its own slot (slotAt, else scheduledFor), in ms. Started runs only; unstarted are counted apart.

metrics.label: Revoke / forget freeze, revocation index ready
metrics.description: revoke scenario, actions that ran with memory_revocation_index_build.ready=1 before and after: per action (1-2 archives, 2 forgets of what the session with the most source-citing receipts rests on), the larger of the event-loop max and the slowest health request in the action's window, in ms. Fails when fewer than 1 archive and 2 forget actions could be built.

metrics.label: Revoke / forget freeze, revocation index building
metrics.description: As the ready row, for actions that ran with ready=0 before and after: the SCALE_REVOKE_INDEX=building pass (index reset on the copy, revoke first and alone), merged with gate.mjs --with. An action whose state flipped counts in neither row.

metrics.label: Event-loop stall during turns (per-second max)
metrics.description: turnPrep scenario window: per second, the worst event-loop stall (the [eld] histogram max, or the gap between two [eld] lines minus 1 s), in ms.

metrics.label: Chat during the post-upgrade check: message accepted
metrics.description: chatDuringPostUpgradeCheck scenario: per send to Sable while the check runs, the POST /api/bots/:id/messages response time, in ms.

metrics.label: Chat during the post-upgrade check: message received to engine started
metrics.description: chatDuringPostUpgradeCheck scenario: per send, the turn's own dispatch.send mark in ms from the server receiving it.

metrics.label: Event-loop stall during the post-upgrade check
metrics.description: chatDuringPostUpgradeCheck scenario, from the first send to the end of the check: per second, the worst event-loop stall (as stallAll), in ms.

metrics.label: Post-upgrade check progress never frozen (longest time at one percent)
metrics.description: chatDuringPostUpgradeCheck scenario: the longest time /api/health upgrade progress stayed at one percent, in ms.

metrics.label: Post-upgrade check reported complete by the server
metrics.description: chatDuringPostUpgradeCheck scenario: 1 when the server reported the post-upgrade check complete (the upgrade contract says so explicitly), 0 when it never did within the cap.

metrics.label: Messages that failed during the post-upgrade check
metrics.description: chatDuringPostUpgradeCheck scenario: the number of messages sent during the post-upgrade check that did not complete as a turn; none may fail.

metrics.label: Messages with every clock measured during the post-upgrade check
metrics.description: chatDuringPostUpgradeCheck scenario: 1 only when every message got all three clocks (accepted, engine started, first text) and completed; a missing timing is a failure, not a smaller sample.

metrics.label: Event-loop stall, whole run (per-second max)
metrics.description: The whole rig run, every scenario: per second, the worst event-loop stall (the [eld] histogram max, or the gap between two [eld] lines minus 1 s), in ms.

metrics.label: Storage: lineage tables (end of run)
metrics.description: dbstat bytes of the lineage group (line lineage, carries, flows, captures, session lineage, deny_*, every root-set table) over the messages b-tree. One per-line context table (messages x context) fails it.

metrics.label: Storage: receipt tables (end of run)
metrics.description: dbstat bytes of memory_disclosures, _refs and _outputs over the messages b-tree. Any per-output fan-out fails it.

metrics.label: Storage: sources and versions (end of run)
metrics.description: dbstat bytes of memory_sources, _source_versions and _source_origins over the messages b-tree. A third copy of the text fails it.

metrics.label: Storage: whole file, live bytes (end of run)
metrics.description: (page_count - freelist_count) x page_size over the messages b-tree. Backstop: the group rows carry the weight.

metrics.label: Storage: file vs live after idle maintenance
metrics.description: messages.db size on disk (log checkpointed) over its live bytes, after the run's idle window (SCALE_IDLE_MS, past the server's 5 minute idle mark). Proves reclaim and incremental vacuum work.

metrics.label: Storage: bytes per new message, late vs early
metrics.description: Slope session: live bytes per new message over the last 10% of its turns against the first 10%. Catches messages x context even when totals look fine early.

metrics.label: Storage: events/ total (end of run)
metrics.description: Bytes of every file under the data dir's events/ at the end of the run (the native/ budget). events/ keeps forgotten text verbatim, so it is a privacy row too.

metrics.label: Background CPU while the owner types
metrics.description: typing scenario: CPU of the server process tree (engines and memory worker included, the load generator not), in cores, sampled each second while Playwright types into the composer for 30 s without sending.
